item.title: Version 0.19.4
item.description:
SupaSidebar 0.19.4

Improvements

  • Search Button in Compact Sidebar: A new magnifying-glass button in the compact sidebar top bar opens the command panel without reaching for a shortcut.
  • Turn Off Hover Previews: Tooltip and folder preview delay pickers now include an Off option that disables hover previews entirely.

Bug Fixes

  • The sidebar now docks to the side edge when you switch stages in Stage Manager, instead of stranding mid-screen on the new stage’s app.
  • Files now disappear from the file browser the instant you choose Move to Trash, instead of lingering until you reopen the folder.
